fixtures.title: Stale tab writes over a newer draft revision
fixtures.scenario: Tab A saves decision X at revision 7. Tab B, still holding revision 6, saves decision Y.

projections.gm: queue unchanged; no partial state visible
projections.ownerPlayer: conflict notice with reload-and-reapply guidance; unsent intent preserved locally until reconciled

expected.retryBehavior: resubmitting the same stale revision fails identically; reload obtains revision 7 and reapplies intent
expected.rollback: no draft change from the stale write

fixtures.title: GM publishes policy v2 while a draft is bound to v1
fixtures.scenario: A draft in progress under policy v1; the GM publishes v2 with a different starter pool.

projections.gm: queue shows draft pinned to v1 with an explicit upgrade/restart offer
projections.ownerPlayer: draft continues unchanged under v1; informational notice that a newer policy exists

expected.retryBehavior: draft mutations keep validating against v1 until the GM explicitly migrates or supersedes
expected.rollback: not applicable; no state was invalidated

fixtures.title: Sheet slug collision discovered during approval commit
fixtures.scenario: Between approval preview and commit, a GM manually creates a sheet occupying the planned slug.

projections.gm: approval fails with the colliding resource named and a re-plan action; no partial rows
projections.ownerPlayer: submission remains approved-pending; no completion event

expected.retryBehavior: exact retry of the failed commit returns the same failure; re-planning allocates fresh slugs and succeeds
expected.rollback: entire transaction rolled back: no sheet, link, team, inventory, equipment, or provenance rows

fixtures.title: Submission carrying a forged or stale choice ID
fixtures.scenario: A tampered client submits a package whose feature choice violates prerequisites or references an unknown catalog ID.

projections.gm: no review item created for the invalid submission
projections.ownerPlayer: blocking issues listing each failed decision with stable codes and owning decisions

expected.retryBehavior: identical submission fails identically; resolving the named decisions permits a new submission revision
expected.rollback: draft remains in draft state; no snapshot created

fixtures.title: Server crash between approval acceptance and commit completion
fixtures.scenario: The GM approves; the server restarts mid-transaction before the completion record is durable.

projections.gm: blocking reconciliation state: approval outcome unknown until the operation journal is consulted
projections.ownerPlayer: blocking reconciliation state; no second submission offered

expected.retryBehavior: retry with the original operation ID returns the journaled terminal result: either the full committed package or the rolled-back failure; never a second package
expected.rollback: SQLite transaction semantics guarantee all-or-nothing; the journal records which side of the boundary was reached

fixtures.title: Owner edits while the GM reviews a submission
fixtures.scenario: A submitted snapshot is under review while the owner keeps editing the live draft.

projections.gm: review target remains the immutable submitted snapshot; a marker shows newer draft edits exist
projections.ownerPlayer: edits accumulate on the draft as a prospective new revision; the submitted snapshot is read-only

expected.retryBehavior: approving the reviewed snapshot re-authorizes against it, not the live edits; changed material requires a new submission revision

fixtures.title: Bound player profile removed mid-draft
fixtures.scenario: The GM deletes or unbinds the player profile that owns an active draft.

projections.gm: slot flagged blocked with rebind/cancel options
projections.ownerPlayer: draft locked with a safe explanation; no mutation accepted

expected.retryBehavior: mutations fail with the same ownership rejection until the GM rebinds or cancels
expected.rollback: draft content preserved; nothing deleted implicitly

fixtures.title: Server restart in the middle of building
fixtures.scenario: The player is mid-decision when the server restarts and the realtime channel drops.

projections.ownerPlayer: reload restores the exact current decision, accepted choices, and validation from the durable draft

expected.retryBehavior: any in-flight mutation retries with its operation identity; accepted-before-restart returns the stored result, unaccepted applies fresh
